Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from all of us for this encounter and ODI series. We hope you enjoyed our coverage of the game. These two sides now lock horns in the T20I series starting on April 4, 2017 at 1900 local time (1330 GMT). Until then, it's goodbye and cheers!

Sri Lanka captain Upul Tharanga says that his team played really well. Thinks that the run outs cost them the momentum but Thisara Perera played well to bring things back in control. Calls Thisara's knock a very important one. Says that the all-rounder really showed that he can hit the ball really well.

Bangladesh captain, Mashrafe Mortaza says that they were not upto the mark. Opines that they lost the match in the first ten overs of either innings. Says that they lost too many wickets early and adds that Sarkar and Shakib did play well but couldn't carry on. Ends by saying that they will work on their mistakes and try to improve in their next ODI assignment against Ireland.
Man of the Series, Kusal Mendis (translated from Sinhalese) says that he is extremely happy with his performance. Credits his team for always showing confidence in him.

Man of the Match, Thisara Perera starts off saying that he is really happy with his batting. He has given his everything in practice. Mentions that he has come back after six months and wants to really do well in the future. Credits his practice sessions for his good show.

Earlier in the match, Gunathilaka and Tharanga gave their side a dream start - 76 in the first ten overs. Though Bangladesh pulled things back in the middle overs, a breezy knock from Thisara ensured that they posted a par total on board. How important was his knock? Who will be the Man of the Match? Thisara or Kulasekara? Let's find out at the presentation....

A lot was expected from Mahmudullah, but Suranga Lakmal got rid of him early. Mehedi Hasan along with Taskin Ahmed stitched together a stand of 54 to frustrate the Islanders. In the process, Mehedi Hasan also slammed his maiden fifty to showcase his potential. But it was never going to be enough as Nuwan Kulasekara struck twice in the final over to help his side win the match and level the series. Coming to the other Sri Lankan bowlers, all were economical. The pick though was Kulasekara who finished with figures of 7.3-0-37-4.

If one asks me where did the chase become really difficult for Bangladesh - I would suggest after the first four overs. Bangladesh lost three big wickets in Tamim Iqbal, Sabbir Rahman and Mushiqur Rahim. Those dismissals broke the back of the chase pretty early. Though Shakib Al Hasan and Soumya Sarkar stuck around to steady the ship with a 77-run stand, Dilruwan Perera bowled a beauty to get rid of the latter. Shakib was having issues with his back which might have led to his wicket as he looked to really go after the bowling once he got to his fifty.

Misfield! Bowls a fuller delivery and on the stumps, Shakib looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and rolls towards gully. The fielder fails to stop it and they take a run.
Angles in a full ball and on off, Sarkar pushes it with soft hands towards covers.
Good length delivery, on off, Sarkar is rock solid in defense.
On a length and around off again, Sarkar defends it.
Bowls it slightly slower and on the sticks, Soumya blocks it watchfully.
Fuller length and on the stumps, Al Hasan knocks it down the ground and takes a quick single.
On a length and outside off, Shakib pushes it towards point.
Fuller length and on the stumps, Shakib looks to flick but it goes off the inner half of the willow towards short fine leg. Single taken.
Short of a length and outside off, Sarkar steers it down to third man for one run.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Shakib dabs it through third man for a single. Gets off the mark.
Shakib Al Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! Bangladesh are falling apart. Wonder why Mushfiqur Rahim reviewed it considering he wasn't very sure. Lakmal bowls this on a length, on the sticks, Rahim looks to defend but plays down the wrong line. The ball brushes his front pad before going onto ping him on his back leg. The players appeal and the umpire rules it out. Rahim comes over to have a chat with Sarkar, he does not look sure yet goes for the review. Replays show that it has pitched around off, the impact is also in line. It is shown to be clipping the top of the middle stump and hence the umpire's call remains! Huge wicket this for the visitors.
Rahim is given out lbw. He is not that confident enough yet goes for the review. Looks out!
Fuller length and around off, Soumya drives it through covers for a single.
Continues from around the wicket.  On a length and it nips back in, Sarkar blocks it.
Mushfiqur Rahim is the new man in.

OUT! Sabbir Rahman departs for a duck. Nuwan Kulasekara has his second. He bowls it on a length and very wide, Rahman throws his bat at it and looks to cut. The ball takes the outside edge. Dinesh Chandimal goes to his right and grabs it. A dream start for the hosts. They are very ecstatic and let Rahman know what they think about it. A poor shot from Sabbir really, he could have left that ball alone. He should be very upset with that shot.
On a length and outside off, Rahman pats it to the cover-point fielder.
Bowls this full and on the off stump, Sabbir goes back and defends.
On a length and around leg, Sarkar flicks it through backward square leg for a single.
Very full and on the sticks, Sarkar knocks it down the ground.
Good length delivery, outside off, Sarkar looks to cut but gets a bottom edge back on the pitch.

Bizarre scenes! Apparently Prasanna was sledging Sabbir Rahman, to which the batsman started warming up with his bat. Prasanna was standing very close and the batsman's willow could've hit him. That could have been nasty, really.
Goes round the wicket and bowls this on a length, Sarkar looks to push but it goes off the inside edge to mid on. They run through for a single.
FOUR! Outstanding stroke. Lakmal bowls this full and on leg, Sarkar flicks it uppishly through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Fuller length and in the line of the fourth stump, Soumya pushes it towards covers.
Marginally ahead of a length and around off, Sarkar has blocked it.
Back of a length delivery, outside off, Sarkar taps it to point.
On a length and around off, Sarkar drives this towards covers.
Suranga Lakmal to bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Sabbir Rahman walks in next.

OUT! Clean catch and Iqbal has to depart! Nuwan Kulasekara bowls a length delivery on the stumps, Iqbal looks to flick but it takes the leading edge and flies towards the bowler. He catches it, leaping to his right but drops it as he starts celebrating. The umpire though decides to take it upstairs. Replays suggest that the bowler had grabbed it cleanly only to put it down while trying to celebrate. The third umpire rules it a legal catch and conveys the same. Tamim Iqbal does not agree with it but he can't do anything about it.

The umpire have gone upstairs to check a return catch of Tamim Iqbal. The bowler seemed to have caught it but dropped it while celebrating. Is it out or not? Sri Lanka think it is and they are celebrating. Let's find out what the third umpire has to say.
Tamim cuts this length delivery towards covers.

FOUR! What a lucky way to get off the mark. Good length delivery, outside off, Tamim Iqbal looks to cut but only manages an outside edge which goes between Chandimal, the keeper and the first slip fielder. It rolls away for a boundary. To be honest, it was the keeper's catch and he should've gone for it.
Marginally ahead of a length and in the line of the fourth stump, Tamim defends it very close to the body towards the off side.
Fuller again and outside off, Iqbal leans forward and lets it through.
Initiates his spell with a full length delivery, outside off, it swings away after Tamim leaves it alone.
Welcome back for the chase! The two Bangladesh openers Tamim Iqbal and Soumya Sarkar are out to bat. Sri Lanka begin the proceedings with Nuwan Kulasekara! A slip in place for him, here we go...
